main_body: Three stacked barrels (one on top, two below) drawn as front-facing brown barrels with red/pink bands and a dark outline
top_band: none: the top of each barrel is a 1-2 row dark brown/orange rim at the top edge (rows ~2-3 for the top barrel, ~7-8 for the lower ones), not an ellipse surface
evidence: Each keg is drawn straight from the front. Down the middle column of a barrel you meet a dark outline row, a thin orange cap line of 1-2 rows, then banded staves with red hoops. No ellipse lid, no lighter horizontal surface and no front-edge line is visible. This matches the guide's 'barrel: lid 2px' rim-only failure, not the green ellipse-top barrel.

style.evidence: Outline is dark brown, tinted toward the material, so it passes on that point. But each barrel has only about 3 lightness steps in the wood and 3 in the red bands. The staves and bands are mostly flat fills with no grain, speckle or per-stave highlights. Tiles carry roughly 3-5 colours against the reference stall and well, which have scalloped roofs, stone shading and wood grain. Next to the reference the kegs look thinner and flatter.
